issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'dẫu một người cũng không' (even one person not) at the end, which is a redundant emphatic expansion. The Greek 'ουδε εις' (neither/not even one) is already contained within the phrase 'ουκ εστιν δικαιος ουδε εις' (there is no righteous one, not even one). The Vietnamese phrasing creates a repetitive structure not present in the Greek.
